description.content:
Public content API for perfectday.com, served by the WordPress REST API `wp/v2` namespace. Perfect Day is a precision-fermentation food-ingredient company and publishes no product/developer API; this is the one machine-readable surface it operates. Read operations on this resource were verified to respond anonymously (HTTP 200) on 2026-08-02; write operations require authentication (WordPress application passwords). This document was DERIVED by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline from the route metadata the server itself publishes at https://perfectday.com/wp-json/wp/v2 — no operations, parameters, enums or defaults were invented.
